_comment: Slot 2 of a reading: which part of you took the angle, by tone.
── The one rule these all obey ──
Every entry begins with a back-reference. 'It' is the aspect that slot 1
has just described, and this sentence says something about that. None of
these may introduce a subject of its own.
That is not a style preference. Fourteen of these used to open a new
topic, and the failure was visible on the page: 'Go somewhere you have
not been. The discipline is available today without costing what it
usually costs.' Both sentences are fine. Together they are two unrelated
remarks, because 'the discipline' has no antecedent anywhere on the card.
Full rules in .docs/MyBirth-Plan/10-CORPUS.md section 3a. Before adding
an entry here, read it after the three least related openings in
readings.json and check it still parses.

sun.charged: Your sense of yourself is doing the reacting, which is why it feels personal.
sun.open: Your sense of yourself is the part with room in it today.
sun.friction: It is your sense of yourself under the pressure, so it will read as criticism even where none is meant.
sun.easy: Your sense of yourself is steady underneath it, which is why none of this costs much.
sun.pull: Your sense of yourself is on one end of this and something else is on the other.

moon.charged: It is landing on your mood rather than your judgement, and mood always arrives first.
moon.open: What you need is easier to say than usual today, and easier to hear.
moon.friction: It is your need for things to be settled that is taking the strain.
moon.easy: Your footing is good, so you can afford to feel the whole of it.
moon.pull: What you need and what is being asked of you are at opposite ends of this.

mercury.charged: It is landing on how you put things, so the wording matters more today than the point.
mercury.open: It is reaching the part of you that finds the words, and today they are there.
mercury.friction: It is your way of putting things under strain, not what you actually mean by them.
mercury.easy: It lands on how you say things, and the saying is the easy part today.
mercury.pull: What you want to say and what wants saying are pulling in different directions.

venus.charged: It is landing on what you want, which is why it will not stay quiet.
venus.open: What you are drawn to is unusually within reach today.
venus.friction: It is what you want that is under strain, and wanting has never been a plan.
venus.easy: What you want and what is available are close together today.
venus.pull: What you want is on one side of this and what you already have is on the other.

mars.charged: It is landing on your drive, which is why it will present itself as urgency.
mars.open: It is reaching the part of you that pushes, and the push does not have to be forced today.
mars.friction: It is your drive taking the resistance, which is why it reads as frustration.
mars.easy: It lands on your appetite for effort, and the effort goes in cleanly today.
mars.pull: Your pace and somebody else's are at opposite ends of this.

jupiter.charged: It is landing on the part of you that wants more, and that part is not subtle.
jupiter.open: It is reaching the part of you that wants more room, and the room is genuinely there.
jupiter.friction: It is your appetite for more being checked, and the check is a fair one.
jupiter.easy: It lands where you tend to overreach, and today the reach costs less than usual.
jupiter.pull: It has your appetite for more at one end and your need to hold steady at the other.

saturn.charged: It is landing on the part of you that carries things, and that part is already tired.
saturn.open: It is reaching the part of you that keeps things standing, and building is unusually easy today.
saturn.friction: It is the part of you that carries things taking the weight, which is why it feels heavy.
saturn.easy: It lands on the part of you that counts the cost, and today the cost is low.
saturn.pull: What is owed and what is wanted are at opposite ends of this.

uranus.charged: It is landing on the part of you that will not stay put, and that part does not ask first.
uranus.open: It is reaching the part of you that likes a break in the pattern, and today there is somewhere to put it.
uranus.friction: It is your dislike of being held in place that is taking the strain.
uranus.easy: It lands on the part of you that will not stay put, and the change can be made without a fight.
uranus.pull: What you want to keep and what you want to break are at opposite ends of this.

neptune.charged: It is landing where your edges are softest, and soft edges take a mark easily.
neptune.open: What you imagine is unusually close to what you could actually do today.
neptune.friction: It is the part of you that would rather not look directly at it that is taking the strain.
neptune.easy: It is reaching the softest part of you, and today the generous read of things is the accurate one.
neptune.pull: What you hope is true and what you can show is true are pulling apart here.

pluto.charged: It is landing on the part of you that does not negotiate, and it does not negotiate.
pluto.open: Something you keep well below the surface has a way out today that costs nothing.
pluto.friction: It is your grip on this that is taking the strain, not the thing you are gripping.
pluto.easy: You can go a long way down today without it costing you the climb back.
pluto.pull: What you will not let go of and what will not stay is the whole of this.

ascendant.charged: It is landing on the face you meet the day with, so this is visible before it is understood.
ascendant.open: It lands on how you come across, and that is easier to steer today than usual.
ascendant.friction: It is the gap between how you land and how you meant to land that is taking the strain.
ascendant.easy: You are being read accurately today, which is rarer than it sounds.
ascendant.pull: It has how you arrive at one end and what is being asked of you at the other.

midheaven.charged: It is landing on your standing, so whatever this is, it happens in public.
midheaven.open: It is reaching your standing, and the version of you other people describe has room to move.
midheaven.friction: It is your sense of what you should have built by now that is taking the strain.
midheaven.easy: What you have been doing quietly is legible to other people today.
midheaven.pull: What you are doing and what you are known for are pulling in different directions.
